name: ActiveCampaign
tagline: Email marketing and automation platform with four plans priced by contact count.
bestFor: Small and mid-size businesses that rely on automated email sequences
description: ActiveCampaign is an email marketing and marketing automation platform with a visual automation builder, segmentation and optional CRM. It sells Starter, Plus, Pro and Enterprise plans whose price rises with the number of contacts, starting at 1,000 contacts.
pros: Multi-step automations on every plan, including Starter
Annual billing cuts the monthly price by roughly 17-21%
Transactional email and SMS sold as add-ons from ActiveCampaign itself
cons: No free plan, only a 14-day trial
Starter limits automations to 5 actions each and has no landing pages
Smallest tier is 1,000 contacts, so very small lists still pay the 1,000-contact price

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Price for 1,000 contacts (smallest tier); 10,000 emails/month (10x contacts). 1 user, 15 active business goals, 5 actions per automation, no landing pages. Annual = $180 billed yearly.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Price for 1,000 contacts (smallest tier); 10,000 emails/month (10x contacts). 1 user, 25 business goals, unlimited automation actions, landing pages and site messages. Annual = $588 billed yearly.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Price for 1,000 contacts (smallest tier); 12,000 emails/month (12x contacts). 3 users, 200 business goals, A/B testing in emails and automations. Annual = $948 billed yearly.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Price for 1,000 contacts (smallest tier); 15,000 emails/month (15x contacts). 5 users, 200 business goals. Annual = $1,740 billed yearly.

sources.label: activecampaign.com: Pricing catalog data used by the pricing page (ac2024, USD)

research.notes: The pricing page renders prices with JavaScript; the figures come from the USD pricing catalog the page loads (yearly totals divided by 12: Starter $180, Plus $588, Pro $948, Enterprise $1,740 at 1,000 contacts; $1,788 / $2,268 / $4,500 / $7,068 at 10,000). Annual billing exists; the saving is not a flat percentage (about 21% Starter, 17% Plus, 20% Pro, 19% Enterprise). The page also advertises a 30-day money-back guarantee. Send limits scale with contacts (10x Starter/Plus, 12x Pro, 15x Enterprise). SMS is an add-on on Plus, Pro and Enterprise (not available on Starter); transactional email is an add-on on all plans. The catalog also contains a separate engagement-based model (ai2026) that is not shown as the main plan cards.

name: Klaviyo
tagline: Email and SMS marketing platform for online stores, priced by active profiles.
bestFor: Ecommerce brands that want email tied to store data
description: Klaviyo is a marketing platform for ecommerce that combines email, SMS, flows, segmentation, reviews and a customer data platform. Its Email and Marketing plans are priced by the number of active profiles, with a free plan for up to 250 active profiles.
pros: Free plan with 250 active profiles and 500 emails a month
Flows, segmentation and A/B testing included
Transactional flow emails available on paid accounts after approval
cons: No annual billing option shown on the pricing page
SMS and MMS are a paid add-on on the Email and Marketing plans
Price climbs quickly past 10,000 active profiles
freePlanDetails: Up to 250 active profiles and 500 emails per month; $5 of mobile messages and $5 of Composer usage per month.

plans.name: Email
plans.notes: Price for 500 active profiles (smallest tier); 5,000 emails/month. Profiles are treated as contacts. SMS/MMS is an add-on.

plans.name: Marketing
plans.notes: Price for 500 active profiles (smallest tier); 5,000 emails/month. Adds social marketing and Customer Hub for the full profile count and reviews with no order limit. Promo: first month for $1 for up to 5,000 active profiles (limited time); regular price shown.

sources.label: help.klaviyo.com: How to use flows to send transactional emails
help.klaviyo.com: Getting started with Landing Pages

research.freePlanLimits: 250 active profiles, 500 emails per month, $5 of mobile messages and $5 of Composer usage per month.
research.notes: Klaviyo prices by active profiles; treated here as contacts. Tier prices come from the slider data embedded in the vendor's pricing page (USD). No annual billing is offered on the page, so annual fields are null. Sends are 10x profiles on both paid plans. Custom plan (talk to sales) covers over 150,000 active profiles. Marketing plan promo: first month $1 for up to 5,000 active profiles. A pricing FAQ says the free plan gets 150 SMS credits, while the plan card says $5 of mobile messages per month; the card is used here. Transactional status for flow emails needs a paid account and Klaviyo review.

name: GetResponse
tagline: Email marketing platform with automation, landing pages, webinars and course tools.
bestFor: Small businesses and creators who want email plus landing pages and webinars
description: GetResponse is an email marketing platform that adds automation workflows, landing pages, a website builder, webinars and online courses. It sells Starter, Marketer and Creator plans priced by list size, plus a custom-priced Enterprise plan and a limited free account.
pros: Free account for up to 500 contacts after the 14-day trial
Unlimited monthly sends on paid plans
cons: Starter allows only one automation workflow and has no A/B testing
SMS and transactional email are only on the custom-priced Enterprise plan
freePlanDetails: Up to 500 contacts (unconfirmed and removed contacts count) and 2,500 messages per month; no A/B tests, landing pages limited to 1,000 unique visits, webinars up to 10 people, GetResponse badge on messages.
trial: 14-day free trial of premium features, no credit card

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Price for 1,000 contacts (smallest tier); unlimited email sends. One automation workflow, landing pages and signup forms, no A/B testing, up to 3 users.

plans.name: Marketer
plans.notes: Price for 1,000 contacts (smallest tier); unlimited email sends. Unlimited automation workflows, A/B testing, abandoned cart recovery, sales funnels, up to 5 users.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: Price for 1,000 contacts (smallest tier); unlimited email sends. Everything in Marketer plus webinars (up to 100 attendees), website builder and course creator.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Adds SMS marketing, transactional emails (API/SMTP), dedicated sending domain and IP, SSO, priority support; monthly, 12-month or 24-month billing.

sources.label: getresponse.com: Can I try GetResponse before I buy?
getresponse.com: How many messages can I send using my Free account?

research.freePlanLimits: 500 contacts and 2,500 messages per month; no A/B tests; landing pages capped at 1,000 unique visits; webinars up to 10 people.
research.notes: The page localised to INR/EUR for this location, but it embeds a USD price table (pricing2025, currency USD), which is used here. 12-month billing is 18% off (per-month figures shown); 24-month billing is only for Enterprise. List tiers: 1k, 2.5k, 5k, 10k, 25k, 50k, 100k. The page meta description says 'Plans from $13.30/mo', which does not match the embedded USD table (lowest is $15.58/month on annual Starter); it may refer to an older or promotional price. A Black Friday banner exists in the page code but was flagged inactive. 50% off monthly plans for nonprofits. Help articles disagree on how many landing pages the free account can publish.

name: Moosend
tagline: Low-cost email marketing and automation tool with one self-serve plan priced by contacts.
bestFor: Small businesses on a tight budget that want unlimited sends
description: Moosend is an email marketing and automation tool owned by Constant Contact, with a newsletter editor, automation workflows, landing pages and forms. It sells one self-serve Pro plan priced by contact count, plus custom-priced Moosend+ and Enterprise plans.
pros: Pro starts at $9 a month for 500 contacts with unlimited sends
20% off with annual billing, 15% off with biannual billing
30-day free trial with no credit card
cons: Transactional email is an add-on on the custom Moosend+ plan, not Pro
No built-in SMS marketing listed on the pricing page
trial: 30-day free trial, no credit card required

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Price for 500 contacts (smallest tier); unlimited email campaigns/sends. 5 team members. Biannual billing $8/month.

plans.name: Moosend+
plans.notes: Custom plan: all Pro features plus chosen add-ons (transactional emails, dedicated IPs, custom reports, SSO & SAML, hosted files, extra team members).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only. All Pro and Enterprise-level features, 10+ team members, account manager, priority support.

research.freePlanLimits: No free plan. The 30-day trial allows unlimited sends to up to 1,000 contacts, 1 published automation workflow, 1 unpublished form and landing page, 2 team members.
research.notes: Prices read from the data attributes of the contact selector on Moosend's pricing page (USD): monthly, biannual (15% off) and annual (20% off) per-month figures, which Moosend rounds to whole dollars. Tiers: 500, 1k, 2k, 3k, 5k, 8k, 10k, 25k and up to 1M contacts. Nonprofits get 25% off, stackable with the annual discount. Pay-as-you-go email credits also exist (350,000 credits for $350, never expire). SMS set to false: the plan comparison lists no SMS channel and searches found only third-party SMS integrations. Founded/HQ not set because no reliable source was checked; the page footer says Moosend is now a Constant Contact company.

name: Omnisend
tagline: Email, SMS and push marketing platform built for online stores.
bestFor: Ecommerce stores that want email and SMS in one tool
description: Omnisend is an ecommerce marketing platform that combines email, SMS/MMS and web push with pre-built store workflows, forms and landing pages. It has a free plan, Standard and Pro plans priced by contact count, and a custom plan above 150,000 active profiles.
pros: Free plan includes pre-built ecommerce workflows, A/B testing and landing pages
Pro includes unlimited emails under a fair-use policy (60x list)
Order confirmation flows can be triggered through the API
cons: SMS/MMS only on the Pro plan, paid per message
freePlanDetails: 250 contacts, 500 emails per month and 500 web push notifications per month; no time limit, no credit card.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Price for up to 500 contacts (smallest paid tier); 6,000 emails/month (12x list). Unlimited web push, custom workflows. Black Friday promo: 30% off for 3 months ($11.20/month); regular price shown.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Price for up to 2,500 contacts (smallest Pro tier; smaller lists pay the same); unlimited emails under fair use (up to 60x list). SMS/MMS from $0.007 per message. Black Friday promo: 30% off for 3 months ($41.30/month); regular price shown.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: For more than 150,000 active profiles; custom SMS rates.

sources.label: omnisend.com: Pricing page script with tier price table
api-docs.omnisend.com: How to enable order confirmation flow

research.notes: Tier prices come from the price table in the vendor's own pricing-page script (USD; local-currency prices are estimates and billing is in USD). No annual billing; the only prepay option shown is 'Pay 3 months upfront (save 30%)', which is the current Black Friday offer (30% off for 3 months). Regular prices are recorded. Global SMS add-on shows a $50/month base with US rates from $0.009 down to $0.007 per SMS by volume. The Standard plan card says 6,000 emails at 500 contacts and the table says 12x list, which agree. Transactional email set true because Omnisend documents order-confirmation flows triggered through its API; it does not offer a general SMTP relay, and password resets on Shopify/WooCommerce are sent by the store platform. Founded 2014 (as Soundest) per Wikipedia; HQ left null because the Wikipedia article carries an undisclosed-paid-editing notice.
